title: Open Studio Residency
source_quote: Haystack's two-week Open Studio Residency is designed to foster artistic exploration at the highest level, and those selected for the highly-competitive program attend for free. MAY 24–JUNE 5, 2026
evidence_sentence: The residency includes access to ceramics studios and covers kiln firing costs as part of studio-associated residency expenses.
evidence_quote: Studio-associated residency costs covered by Haystack are coal, gas, studio consumables, and kiln firings.
summary: A two-week residential opportunity for advanced artists 21+ to work in open studios including ceramics. Free tuition, room and board. Kiln firing costs covered.
how_to_join: Submit portfolio through SlideRoom; competitive selection based on work samples and project scope
bring: Personal materials for your work; campus store stocks limited clay
cost_text: Free tuition, room, and board; participants pay for travel and materials used
